selected_story_lens: Shared external villain from one visible couple mistake
emotional_machine: navigation disagreement -> first proof of rightness -> repeated situation reverses the power -> both point away from each other -> the road becomes the villain -> wrong turn becomes same team
proof_engine: Two missed cuts, one left and one right, plus +17 minutes as the public receipt.
reader_mirror: Couples who have mutually blamed roads/maps/service lanes will see themselves immediately.
distribution_reason: The CTA names a familiar tag behavior: send this to the person you get lost with and blame infrastructure with.

human_story_setup.cold_reader_doorway: left? / seedha? is an instantly recognizable navigation argument.
human_story_setup.emotional_obstacle: A wrong turn can become a blame fight unless the couple finds a shared outside villain.
human_story_setup.visible_human_proof: Both partners point at the confusing road/map, not each other, after the second miss.
human_story_setup.active_partner_role: Aachu acts through confident direction and comic victory; Zuv acts by asking where, driving, and not turning the second mistake into punishment. Both become active in shared blame.
human_story_setup.emotional_turn: The line shifts from who was right to what was wrong: not you / not me / this.
human_story_setup.shareable_setup: +17 minutes is the receipt every scroller understands.

success_definition.audience_success: A cold viewer sends/tags a partner because the scene mirrors their own wrong-turn arguments.
success_definition.creative_success: The carousel works visually without caption: road split, missed cut, car interior lecture, second split, shared pointing, detour receipt, arrival payoff.
success_definition.brand_success: Warm desi relationship comedy with observational intimacy and no forced rescuer dynamic.
success_definition.production_success: Proof first, then native 4:5 and 9:16 finals with exact text, identity, style, and QA.

stage_scene_gate.action: They choose straight vs cuts at two confusing flyovers/service lanes.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: First she celebrates being right; later both point at the road/map instead of each other.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Eyes track the missed cuts, dashboard/map, and finally the betraying road.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: Driver hands on wheel, Aachu lecture hand, both fingers pointing outward at the confusing road/map, tiny car looping on map.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: Slide 5 has a comic pause where the blame turns outward.
